slices.title: Frame the top-down arena (high-angle camera, bounds, visible-ground extent)
slices.feelIntent: Establish the bounded top-down / high-angle arena frame (orthographic-or-high-angle rig, pitch 55-90 down) so every later slice composes inside it. The play space must read TOP-DOWN, not over-shoulder. The visible ground-plane width is machine-checked so a character-as-a-speck over-wide frame (the dogfood ~54m miss) cannot pass unnoticed.

verifiedBy: framing gate (framing.camera.visibleGroundWidthM, band 24-32m; refuses when captured camera height/pitch/FOV is absent)
criteria.note: Deterministic Tier-1 framing gate over the captured camera evidence. The 24-32m band is declared in acceptance.json and is an exemplar arena read, not a per-run anecdote.

slices.title: Twin-stick controller + top-down camera follow / look-ahead
slices.feelIntent: Twin-stick movement plus the top-down follow camera. Movement and camera are ONE slice because the camera DAMPS toward the player and LEADS the aim/movement vector (the twin-stick look-ahead the dogfood spec named: half-life 0.10-0.18s, look-ahead 2-4m). Collide-and-slide along walls preserves tangential speed (never the frozen-controller regression).

verifiedBy: deriveAccelTo90 (time to reach 90% of target speed)
deriveCameraFollowDamping.halfLifeMs + .lookAheadOffset (catch-up half-life + steady lead toward the movement vector; honest-or-omit)
deriveWallSlideTangentRatio (tangential speed preserved while pinned against a wall)
criteria.note: Calculators are implemented + covered by synthetic-trace unit tests; a committed LIVE top-down capture (demo-bundles/3d-topdown-*) is deferred, exactly as recorded in methodology-gaps.md. Measure-only; not gate-enforced bands. deriveCameraFollowDamping refuses on a static/non-following rig (never a fabricated value); an instant-snap camera honestly reports halfLifeMs=0.

slices.title: Weapon core: fire -> projectile + aim
slices.feelIntent: Firing spawns a visible projectile with a crisp cadence and travel speed, aimed along the twin-stick aim vector. Cadence, input-to-spawn latency, true-3D projectile speed, and aim turn rate are measure-only.

criteria.note: Measure-only calculators (implemented + unit-tested); no committed live top-down capture yet. Recoil / ADS remain explicit gaps (no calculator).

slices.title: Reference enemy + reaction + cover + health/damage/death
slices.feelIntent: Reference enemy takes projectile damage and dies; it reacts to the player only through a real line-of-sight perception (LOS-gated), and cover between player and enemy blocks damage. First-hit to death, LOS-gated reaction latency, and cover-blocks-damage are measurable.

verifiedBy: deriveEnemyReactionLatencyMs (LOS-gated perception -> reaction; real Linecast, not a timer)
deriveCoverBlocksDamage (miss-vs-block guarded on an isolated lane)
criteria.note: deriveCoverBlocksDamage and deriveEnemyReactionLatencyMs are live-proven in the 3d-shooter substrate ledger (Phase-05/Phase-03); a top-down-specific committed capture is deferred here. Geographic-danger / sightline authoring as a DESIGN RULE is a gated single-source candidate (see methodology-gaps.md), not bound as contract material.

slices.title: Combat feedback (muzzle / hit-spark / shake / hit-stop)
slices.feelIntent: Fire and impact read clearly through muzzle flash, hit spark, a brief hit-stop, and a top-down camera kick. The hit-stop WINDOW and the camera-DISPLACEMENT magnitude are measurable; muzzle/hit-spark QUALITY remain design intent.

criteria.note: hitstop + true-3D shake are live-proven in the shared 3d impact-feedback fixture (demo-bundles/3d-impact-feedback/, causality-gated); a top-down-rig capture is deferred. Muzzle flash / hit-spark quality are gaps (design intent, not measured).

slices.title: Loot pickup loop (channelled pickup -> stash)
slices.feelIntent: The greed loop's acquisition beat: a crate is picked up over a channelled window and adds to the run stash. Pickup timing and value are read from the ground-truthed telemetry stream, not a bespoke gate.

verifiedBy: events: loot_start / loot_complete / loot_cancel (t in seconds, global monotonic)
criteria.note: Telemetry schema is ground-truthed against real dogfood-project PlaytestData (T3-T). This slice verifies the pickup EVENTS fire with honest values; the greed-TUNING grammar (first-crate-safe / second-not-free / third-is-the-decision, high-loot-behind-route-cost) is a gated single-source candidate (see methodology-gaps.md), NOT bound here.

slices.title: Extraction hold-to-bank
slices.feelIntent: The commit beat: standing in the extract zone runs a hold that, if not cancelled, banks the carried stash. The hold start / cancel / complete and the banked value are read from the ground-truthed telemetry stream.

criteria.note: Primary binding is the ground-truthed telemetry (real extract_hold_* events). The feel calculators deriveHoldChannelDuration + deriveHoldInterruptOnDamage + deriveZoneObjectiveComplete are IMPLEMENTED and unit-tested but not yet backed by a committed live top-down capture (mirrors the 3d-shooter hold-channel ledger); do not claim them live-proven.

slices.title: Enemy pressure / heat ramp signal
slices.feelIntent: The run's rising-danger signal: a pressure phase begins and the heat / nearest-enemy proximity rises over the run. This slice verifies the pressure SIGNAL is emitted and rises honestly; it deliberately does NOT bake in WHY pressure rises.

criteria.note: deriveThreatRampSlope is implemented + unit-tested but not backed by a committed live top-down capture (live-deferred). The DESIGN RULES pressure-tied-to-greed-not-clock and opener-only-nearest-spawn are gated single-source candidates (methodology-gaps.md), NOT bound here — this slice only checks the heat/proximity signal is present and monotone-ish, never that danger is tied to greed.

slices.title: Strategic minimap (informs without revealing)
slices.feelIntent: A spatial minimap that gives the player strategic reads WITHOUT solving the route for them: it shows broad authored danger zones ('this area is getting dangerous'), and deliberately withholds per-crate loot markers and exact-position enemy radar. This informs-not-reveals property is a dual-validated design contract (taught independently in the codex-tuning session and the Claude session).

requires: broad authored danger zones are present on the minimap
forbids: exact-position enemy radar / precise enemy dots
minimapContract.coverageAnecdote: ~22-26% of the arena visible at once was the single dogfood-project read — ILLUSTRATIVE anecdote only, NOT a band and NOT machine-enforced

verifiedBy: ui-conformance gate (widget placed + inside the safe area)
criteria.note: Tier-1 ui-conformance verifies the minimap widget is present and safe-area-legal. The informs-not-reveals CONTRACT is qualitative (a human/design checklist), never a deterministic gate — encoded here as first-class contract material because it is one of only two dual-validated extraction-shooter learnings.

slices.title: HUD (score / ammo / health)
slices.feelIntent: Score, ammo, and health read clearly and stay inside the safe area (top-down HUD; health as 3 hearts with a stable empty-pip on loss).

verifiedBy: ui-conformance gate (HUD elements present + inside the safe area, per acceptance.json hud.elements)
criteria.note: Structural HUD slice — verified by the deterministic ui-conformance gate; no feel calculator or telemetry binding is claimed.

slices.title: Extraction win / lose-on-death end-state
slices.feelIntent: The run resolves: a completed extraction banks the stash (win), and dying loses the carried stash (lose). Objective completion is measurable via the wave/objective calculator; the banked-vs-lost outcome is read from the ground-truthed telemetry.

verifiedBy: deriveWaveObjectiveComplete (spawn-N -> clear -> complete, kill-gated to the TRUE clear)
telemetry: outcome, bankedValue, lostValue, event death{lost}
deriveStashLossOnDeath (carried stash lost on death) — implemented, unit-tested, live-deferred
criteria.note: deriveWaveObjectiveComplete is live-proven in the 3d-shooter substrate ledger (Phase-06). deriveStashLossOnDeath is implemented + unit-tested but not backed by a committed live top-down capture. The banked-vs-lost run outcome is also directly readable from the ground-truthed telemetry summary (outcome/bankedValue/lostValue).
